launches.body:
# Healthcare’s Growing Information Overload Problem

[Recent regulations](https://www.healthit.gov/topic/interoperability/policy/trusted-exchange-framework-and-common-agreement-tefca) have enabled electronic health record systems to communicate more effectively. However, healthcare providers are not adequately equipped to manage the substantial influx of unstructured data resulting from this enhanced interoperability.

The average patient record is now the equivalent of half the size of Shakespeare's 'Hamlet,' and providers often see more than 20 patients per day. For each patient, these providers find themselves contacting other organizations to obtain the patient’s complete history. Then, they must sift through numerous pages of raw PDFs to locate critical, relevant information — similar to finding a needle in a haystack. This process creates an enormous cognitive burden, leading to burnout, missed revenue opportunities, and, most critically, uninformed care.

# [**Hona**](https://www.hona.ai) is transforming the complexity of healthcare data into something radically simple

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77965&key=user_uploads/771214/1541c2f1-a4d9-42f3-ba7b-7ee0cef242b9)

Hona integrates with electronic health record systems to collect and condense medical histories, enabling providers to fully understand their patients by finding data previously lost in mountains of charts. It searches nationwide for patient data based on providers' schedules, condensing notes, lab results, and more into specialty-specific clinical summaries with links to original sources. Hona then converts its clinical summaries into value-based care metrics, risk scores, and quality measures for practice-level insights.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77965&key=user_uploads/771214/f984dca9-3ba5-45dd-8e5a-41d4d7a3f707)

# Founding Team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77965&key=user_uploads/771214/3db96f3c-16b4-4b17-bee8-128322c0a003)

Hona was founded by ex-biomedical engineers seeking to return to their roots. Drawing from our experience in early-stage startups and launching AI products for millions of users in big tech, we ventured back into healthcare. We are addressing a critical issue: the complexity of healthcare data, which has not just hurt providers within our families and networks, but also us in our roles as patients.

# Call to Action

If you know anyone in a provider organization who is looking to make sense of their data to increase revenue and automate visit prep, please reach out to [tech@hona.ai](mailto:tech@hona.ai).

We’ve all been there: you have a simple problem that you take to customer support, but you’re forced into a never-ending cycle of being passed between different agents and explaining your situation for the (n + 1)th time.

**2. Fragmentation:** You start a chat on your phone, move to your desktop, and have to explain your account number and issue for the third time.

**3. Dumb automation:** You talk with a chatbot that acts as a gatekeeper, not a helper.

**4. Costly, slow onboarding:** Onboarding a new customer support agent brings an expensive and time-consuming burden.

Customer relationships begin with a 7-day free trial, allowing for onboarding and for potential customers to confirm that there is a fit.

We thrive where volume is high and customer support is managed by a number of human customer support agents, either domestically or overseas. If you’re a company with a backlog of support tickets, even better: we’ll take care of your entire backlog on Day 1.

* **Scaling customer support with headcount is expensive:** Human resources account for 90%+ of customer support expenses.
* **Customer support agents burn out:** Support tasks incur large amounts of manual, repetitive, and ungratifying work that humans don't need to be doing, causing burnout, turnover, and reduced quality.
* **Customer support is more than a chatbot on a website:** In an API-driven world, customer support tools need to evolve with the company’s tech stack. Existing AI-powered solutions are not delivering on the promise, resulting in sub-par customer experience and low NPS and CSAT scores.
* **Company resources are siloed across systems:** As companies grow, so does their expert knowledge. It is hard to access at scale, and keeping employees up-to-date is nearly impossible.

**Solution**

* **Comprehensive data indexing:** Markprompt addresses the root of the information access problem by indexing all available knowledge within a company, setting the foundation for a robust system of record to feed the AI. This includes:
  * Salesforce Knowledge databases
  * Salesforce and Zendesk tickets
  * Notion wikis
  * GitHub repositories, discussions, and issues
  * Company websites, docs, guides, blogs
* **An API-first approach:** Markprompt is built from the ground up with an API-first approach. Every feature, from indexing and processing of data to generating drafts, triaging tickets, creating chat replies, or triggering automations, can be achieved via our APIs. Markprompt also provides SDKs (such as React hooks and components) and no-code tools to enable integrations at all touchpoints in the customer journey.
* **Deep integrations:** Markprompt works well within existing support platforms, such as Zendesk and Salesforce. And with our APIs, it is possible to build custom integrations to accommodate any setup.

Here is an example of a bespoke ticket deflection and triaging system built with our React libraries:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76470&key=user_uploads/72181/52faa2d8-f529-4ce4-8314-a3f6e5cba849)

**How we help**

* **Efficient ticket deflection:** Deploy AI-driven chatbots and ticket deflection systems that efficiently handle routine queries, allowing support teams to focus on more complex cases.
* **Accelerated case resolution:** Use automated drafts to streamline case resolution, ensuring faster response times based on the up-to-date expert knowledge.
* **Actionable AI agents:** Enable AI agents to perform user actions, such as processing refunds or canceling a subscription, with high accuracy.

**Who we are**

We are life partners, and passionate about design and AI. Michael previously founded Snips (acq. by Sonos), a privacy-respecting voice AI platform that now powers all voice interactions on Sonos speakers. Marie and Michael previously founded [Motif](https://motif.land), a collaborative docs platform based on Markdown and React. While building Motif, we realized that the tasks of maintaining company expert knowledge up to date and providing stellar customer support are intimately connected, and both can in large part be automated. This led us to build Markprompt.

We are backed by founders and operators at Algolia, Microsoft, Snowflake, Stripe and Vercel.

Hey everyone! We're [Nithin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nithin-parsan) and [John](https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnyang101), founders of Reticular.

**TL;DR:**

Reticular gives pharma companies precise control over protein AI models, enabling reliable drug discovery without millions in wasted experiments. We're unlocking encoded information in these models through foundational AI interpretability research, making steering as easy as prompting ChatGPT.

**The Team:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85439&key=user_uploads/684233/c914554d-0323-4701-8892-d9bf859a832c)

Nithin and John are huge AI + Bio nerds who:

* Met 7 years ago competing in International Biology and Neuroscience Olympiads and were roommates at MIT for 4 years
* Published ML/bio research in NeurIPS, Nature, and PLoS ONE

**The Challenge:**

Information in biology is incredibly scarce and expensive to validate. While protein AI models like AlphaFold have revolutionized drug discovery, they're still black boxes:

* Companies waste millions testing AI-generated designs and they can't easily control what these models output
* Limited data makes validation slow and expensive

**Our Approach:**

Instead of trial-and-error, we're leveraging mechanistic interpretability techniques that excel at extracting sparse knowledge from models even with scarce data. We’re demonstrating that the same advances from frontier AI labs in steering models like Claude are applicable to unlock protein language models.

For our design partners, we’re delivering:

* Direct steering of protein models towards desired properties
* Interpretable biological features backing every design
* Efficient exploration of combinatorially massive design spaces with limited data

**See It In Action:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85439&key=user_uploads/684233/3805bd5b-792f-4a8b-bd6c-cffec150612d)

We're steering Green Fluorescent Protein towards more fluorescent sequences by directly controlling the model's internal knowledge.

**Learn More** at [reticular.ai](http://reticular.ai), our proof-of-concept [blog post,](https://nithin-parsan.medium.com/two-neurons-is-all-you-need-a-case-study-on-interpretability-in-protein-models-5295ab9133cb) and at [demo.reticular.ai](http://demo.reticular.ai).

# **⏳TL/DR**

Rovi helps employees access high-quality, cost-effective healthcare. We text employees the best in-network options at exactly the right moment, and handle all the complexity.

* Our AI-enabled virtual care treats common conditions quickly over text or video.
* For complex care, our AI agents search across all in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, then handle scheduling and logistics.
* Employees get rewarded for choosing high-value care through copay reimbursements and waived deductibles.

Launch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKNB0CF8_9Y

# **⚠️ The Problem**

Healthcare costs are crushing employers. 2025 is seeing a 9% rate hike, the worst in a decade. A 1,000-person company now faces over $1M in cost increases annually, compounding.

Employers’ only options are to cut benefits or redesign their entire plan. Both take months and frustrate employees.

What if Employers could offset these costs by adding benefits instead?

## **🤨 How is this possible?**

**Price and quality have no correlation in healthcare:**

* The same MRI: $700 at an imaging center vs $2,500 at a hospital. Same network. Same machine.
* The same knee surgery: $7,000 at a surgery center vs $25,000 at a hospital. Same surgeon. Often better outcomes at the surgery center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94971&key=user_uploads/1230817/7a7a2b27-4c82-410c-9744-82a5af6b1cc2)

**So why does everyone end up with the expensive option?**

1. **Hospitals own the referral pipeline.** They consolidated most primary care practices. When your doctor orders a procedure, their systems automatically directs it to their expensive facilities.
2. **Shopping is impossible.** Prices are hidden, provider directors outdated, quality is opaque. And when you're sick, calling twelve clinics is the last thing you want to do.

**Rovi does the hard work.** Our AI agents analyze terabytes of pricing data, research every provider's quality metrics, and surface options matching each person's preferences for cost, convenience, and availability. Making good healthcare decisions drives down costs for both the employee and the employer.

# **🎯 Impact**

We save employers 10-20% on healthcare spend while improving care outcomes and delivering a health benefit that employees love.

We've already signed contracts to roll out to thousands of employees across multiple employers for the 2025-2026 plan year.

2. **Individuals:** [**Join our beta**](https://rovi.health/) to try our AI care concierge. Rovi will find you great in-network doctors whenever you need care. Virtual care coming soon.

## **👬🏾 Our team**

We're brothers on a mission to build AI-native health insurance that members love.

**Santosh** was previously building Cedar's affordability products, scaling to millions in ARR by closing enterprise deals with the country's largest hospital systems. Before that, he led a 30-person GTM & Customer Success team at AngelList. He’s also a licensed health insurance broker.

**Tarun** built foundational AI models to predict extreme weather events at UChicago, where he earned a Master's in AI and high-performance computing. He has a B.S. in biology from Cornell, and is obsessed with using AI to solve healthcare's messiest data problems.

**TL;DR: [Cova](https://cova.care/) is a licensed home care agency in Michigan. AI agents run the entire back office, which lets us pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state, charge families less, and help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for.**

<https://youtu.be/28Xmk3izvks>

**The problem**

This is one of the largest, fastest-growing markets in the country. 11,000 Americans turn 65 every day, and 70% want to age at home. 53 million people are already unpaid family caregivers, over $1 trillion in economic value every year that the system doesn’t capture.

But getting someone into home care is brutal. The application and paperwork alone take weeks of back-and-forth across a caregiver, a patient and their family, a doctor, and a state caseworker, with paper forms bouncing between all of them. Most of that time isn't care; it's coordination. Most families give up before care ever starts, and caregivers wait unpaid.

When care finally begins, caregivers suffer from missed payments and poor coordination, affecting patients downstream. All of this because existing agencies aren’t built to handle care at scale.

**What Cova does**

We own the full stack: Cova is its own home care agency serving Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients, and AI agents run it end to end.

* **Weeks → days.** AI agents handle the applications and paperwork that normally drags on for weeks in just a few days.
* **Zero FTE overhead = highest caregiver pay in the state.** AI agents do the coordination work, so we carry no non-caregiver headcount and pass that straight to caregivers as the highest base rate in Michigan.
* **We get family caregivers paid.** Millions are already caring for a loved one for free and qualify for programs they've never heard of. AI agents find those programs and get them enrolled and paid.
* **We bill the payers directly.** Because we own the agency, we make money the way agencies do, billing Medicaid, MCOs, LTCI, and private pay, just with a fraction of the cost structure.

**About the team**

**Jordan Ibe (Co-Founder)** – Studied Computer Science & Statistics at Cornell University. Previously a Forward Deployed Software Engineer on Palantir’s Healthcare team and Software Engineer at Uber.

**Ansh Tandon (Co-Founder)** – Completed a BSE & MSE in Bioengineering at the University of Pennsylvania. Previously a Deployment Strategist on Palantir’s Healthcare team and Researcher at Daffodil Health.

## ❌ The problem

Anthea’s sister spent eight years chasing her eczema.

The cause turned out to be dust in the carpet.

No one caught it because no one was recording anything. Her skin was reacting to her sleep, her home, her products, the air around her, and none of it existed as data. Every dermatologist that took months to see started from zero. Every product she tried was a guess.

That is the **$190B** skincare industry in one story. It runs on guessing.

Lumeria ends that: it captures the missing data layer that gives you the power to understand and own your skin's health data, from home.

## 🔬 How it works

The Lumoscope shrinks the multi-spectrum imaging dermatology clinics use into a clip for your phone. Press it against your skin and see yourself in three kinds of light: true color (RGB), UV, and cross-polarized.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/76776eef-52f9-4416-827c-36c74760f8dd)

For the first time, you see what your mirror can't: a breakout building days before it surfaces, sun damage hiding under flawless-looking skin, where inflammation is building up.

Each scan becomes an objective read (hydration, redness, evenness, pigmentation, texture, pores) plus a score out of 100 and a skin age, so you can understand your progress.

Track them over time, and Lumi tells you exactly what to do. 

* It finds the cause, linking your breakouts to habits you'd never think of, from your sleep to your cycle to the pillowcase you forgot to wash. 
* It recommends products from a database of 18000+ products + ingredients, matched to what your scans actually show works.
* It hands your dermatologist 90 days of images, trends, and context in one tap.
* And it compounds: every scan adds to a history and increased understanding of your skin’s relevant context.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/c36570ca-4042-47bc-beb4-5f1a27014d6a)

 It works across every skin tone. It is private and encrypted by default. 

## 👥 Why we built this

Anthea, our CTO, lived with this problem: suffering from eczema that would not heal, five months to reach a dermatologist, four misdiagnoses. She is an engineer who worked on computational biology at Google and Boehringer Ingelheim. Maryanne, our CEO, is a skincare creator with 25M+ views across her UGC portfolio, exited her first biotech company by 19, and still could not explain her own breakouts until Lumeria. We understand the helplessness people feel with their skin, so we built what was needed.

We are patent pending, shipping in Fall 2026, and built on 150+ interviews and 2 clinical partnerships with dermatologists and patients.
